To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) scenes can be detected effectively using a video BoW approach; 2) motion descriptors are better than region descriptors for keyframe selection, but the parameters for the motion descriptor vary significantly from one video to the next; 3) a human-in-the loop approach can achieve superior accuracy to learning- based methods and for many cases is on par with human accuracy.

1) scenes can be effectively detected and 2) motion descriptors provide better keyframes than visual content descriptors, however the best method is to let the user select the best keyframes from the three best methods.
1) scene detection is a key step for video summarization and 2) human assisted keyframe selection is a simple and effective way for video summarization.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of automatic video summarization.
the problem of keyframe-based video summarization with human in the loop.
the problem of video summarization and we present an approach that achieves high accuracy with low computational complexity.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the human assisted keyframe selection is the best choice for video summarization, while scene detection is a good alternative for keyframe extraction.
our human-in-the-loop approach provides a simple yet effective way of producing high quality video summaries.
the keyframe based video summarization is not a solved problem yet and there is a lot of room for improvement in both the automatic and assisted methods.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose a simple method for video summarization that achieves superior accuracy to existing learning-based approaches.
we provide a simple yet effective keyframe selection method which is on par with state-of-the-art methods.
a simple yet effective combination of a scene detection method and a human in the loop approach can provide a very accurate keyframe based video summarization.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a simple human-in-the-loop approach can provide better video summaries compared to more complex learning methods.
a human-in-the loop can significantly improve the performance of video summarization systems.
the keyframe-based video summarization is still far from being solved.
